rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll_From_Temp {
    meta:
        description = "Detects unsigned DLLs loaded from Temp by rundll32"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2D 72 63 34 } // '-rc4' in beacon config
        $dll_load_path = "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" wide ascii
    condition:
        basename(process.filename) == "rundll32.exe" and 
        $dll_load_path in process.command_line and 
        $beacon_config at entrypoint
}

rule GoldenTicket_TGT_Anomaly {
    meta:
        description = "Detects potential Golden Ticket activity via anomalous Kerberos TGT flags and lifetimes"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1558.001"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $s1 = "krbtgt" wide ascii
        $s2 = "TGT" wide ascii
        $s3 = "forwardable" wide ascii
        $s4 = "renewable" wide ascii
        $s5 = "pre-authentication not required" wide ascii
    condition:
